_comment: Works deliberately withdrawn from the corpus. The New Advent manifest is a
faithful record of what that archive holds, so nothing is deleted from it —
these are named here instead, and both the ingester and the completeness
Without it a corpus rebuild would re-ingest every one of them and silently
undo the decision, and audit_completeness.py would report 45 works as a gap
to be filled rather than as a choice already made.
Withdrawn 2026-08-01. See the audit section in TODO.md for the reasoning.
